disclaimer: Top chart is an unaudited practice track (size-normalized). Bottom chart and yearly table are a hypothetical backtest with a documented size-up rule — not an offer to invest. Instrument, session rules, and trade entries/exits are intentionally undisclosed.

methodology.live_size_note: Practice and backtest use the research unit cash scale (point value already in USD).
methodology.size_up_rule: Year 1 trades at base size (1×). At each later calendar year-start, if the prior year's sized PnL is at least 2 × |that year's max drawdown| (lookback DD only — never the full-sample max DD), size permanently steps up by 2×. If a full double would make |prior DD|×2 exceed 40% of equity at review, step by 1.5× instead. Size never steps down; ups may repeat indefinitely. Yearly PnL reflects that path.
methodology.equity_footnote: Campaign cash PnL summed by session date onto a $100,000 starting balance (no compounding). Ranking footnote cites research ≈ +$12,253 / stress ≈ −$1,966 / N/S 6.23.
methodology.practice_note: Hero equity uses practice campaigns actually taken. The series is short and will lengthen as the sleeve trades.

stress_note: Research intrabar stress drawdown was about −$1,966 on the ranking book (N/S 6.23).
